# meltcloud_nest (Data Source)

The [Nest](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/nest/overview), the management appliance that hosts the Foundry and the Kubernetes control planes. Needs the API Key of the admin Organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meltcloud_nest" "this" {}

output "nest_version" {
  value = data.meltcloud_nest.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the Nest on meltcloud
- `name` (String) Name of the Nest, given at install
- `status` (String) Status of the Nest, for example `ready` or `updating`
- `version` (String) The Nest version it runs
